policy: Byte-for-byte copies of completed sweep evidence. Original files remain in place. Historical configuration paths and metadata are preserved. Model checkpoints, normalization pickles, and redundant individual episode archives are omitted. Historical Python source snapshots use a .py.txt suffix to keep them out of import and test discovery; original_path records the original filename where it differs.
